title: Andy Jassy says Prime Video is on track to earn 'tens of billions of dollars' | TechCrunch
summary: Amazon said its movie studio, Amazon MGM Studios, has brought in more than $1.2 billion in global box office sales so far this year, helped by hits like Project Hail Mary and Verity .
